name: homePos
meaning: Init pos or pos at msg 9 arg 1 (the sender's pos); Reset and Update state 2 (crash respawn) return the rocket here.

name: state
meaning: RocketState 0..7 (Rocket_SetState, table 0x576960). Rocket_Render: 4 draws the respawn wobble, 7 draws the gauges.

name: active
meaning: bit 0 of the flag byte +0x83, a one-bit field: Bit 0 is ACTIVE: set by msg 0x15 (start using), cleared by msg 0x16, Init and Reset. Gates msg 0x10 (carry pose 1 gives state 7 flying plus engine sound 0x6e; pose 2 gives state 6).

name: fuel
meaning: remaining fuel in 1/4096 s ticks; msg 0x900 subtracts its arg (g_dt, or g_dt*2 while boosting) and returns 0 when empty; the write is at 0x4e5165

name: hits
meaning: remaining hit points; msg 0x901 subtracts its arg, returns 0 when destroyed; the write is at 0x4e519e

name: stateTime
meaning: g_gameTime stamp: set on entering states 3 and 4 (and 0 in Init). State 3 waits 0x3000 (3 s) hidden; state 4 lasts until ScnObject_IsRespawnWobbleDone (1 s).

name: engineSoundHandle
meaning: looping sound handle; non-zero while the engine sound plays

name: enginePitch
meaning: 4.12 pitch/speed factor 0x1000..0x2000, moves by g_dt/2 per frame toward boost / cruise (2.0 s full ramp)
